images.title: The side of a 441 square metre square
images.purpose: Shows a square of area 441 square metres whose side is 21 metres, the square root of the area.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large square in the centre with its area inside, one side marked, and a check below.
images.exact_structure: One large square filled teal (#0072B2) with 441 m² written in white in its centre. Its bottom side is drawn as a thick reddish purple (#CC79A7) line with a dimension label 21 m under it. A small round amber (#E69F00) drag handle sits at the bottom right corner. Below the square, centred: 21 × 21 = 441. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The side of a square is the positive square root of its area.
images.description: Shows a square of area 441 square metres whose side is 21 metres, the square root of the area.

image_decisions.why: The tool's core action is resizing a square until its area matches, then reading the side as the root.
